summary: The F3800 is Anker's answer to "what if a power station could replace a portable generator entirely." At 3,840Wh and 6,000W of dual-voltage output, it's less a camping accessory and more a wheeled appliance built to sit in a garage and take over the moment the grid drops.

The DJI Power 1000 brings DJI's to the portable power station market. Packing 1,024Wh of LiFePO4 battery capacity and a robust 2,200W output, it is built to handle heavy-duty outdoor gear, rapid drone battery charging, and essential home appliances during a short power outage.

The DELTA Pro 3 packs 4,096Wh of LFP capacity and a 4,000W continuous, dual-voltage inverter into a single wheeled chassis — and backs it with the fastest full recharge of any unit in this class, using EcoFlow's X-Stream fast-charging technology.

The Anker Laptop Power Bank (25K, 165W) is a heavy-duty portable charger that bridges the gap between pocket-sized convenience and workstation-grade power. Featuring 25,000mAh (approx. 90Wh) capacity and a 165W max output across built-in and retractable cables, it delivers some juice for power-hungry laptops and accessories without crossing airline carry-on limits.

The Anker Nano Charger (65W, 3 Ports) punches well above its weight class, delivering 65W max output from its individual USB-C ports—enough to fast-charge a 14-inch MacBook Pro from 0 to 50% in 35 minutes. Built with GaN II technology, it packs multi-device capability into a footprint 41% smaller than standard 65W chargers.

The Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 packs 1,024Wh of LiFePO4 capacity and a robust 2,000W output (3,000W peak) into a footprint 14% smaller and 11% lighter than comparable models. Featuring HyperFlash technology for a 49-minute ultra-fast AC recharge and smart app controls with Time-of-Use (TOU) mode, it is built to serve as a reliable, long-lasting power source.

The Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W) delivers a massive 300W total output across two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, capable of running two laptops simultaneously. Packed with 99.75Wh (26,250mAh) of TSA-approved airline-safe capacity, it supports blazing-fast 140W single-port output and an unprecedented 250W dual-input recharge that hits 100% in just 39 minutes.

The Anker Prime Charger (160W, 3 Ports) packs extreme high-density power into a footprint comparable to an AirPods Pro case. Featuring a true non-derating 140W single-port output and PowerIQ 5.0 smart distribution, it can drive a 16-inch MacBook Pro, an iPad Pro, and an iPhone simultaneously while keeping temperatures low through advanced GaN technology.

The Jackery Explorer 300D is an ultra-portable 288Wh power station weighing just 2.5 kg with a slim portrait design. Featuring a built-in 140W USB-C cable that doubles as a carry handle, dual 140W USB-C ports, and exceptional energy efficiency, it delivers reliable off-grid power ideal for hiking, camping, and running mobile devices or projectors.

The UGREEN Nexode Pro Power Bank (20,000mAh, 165W) features an innovative 65cm built-in roll-up cable, eliminating the need to carry separate wires. Delivering up to 165W total output across multiple ports (100W + 65W simultaneous dual-laptop charging), it combines high capacity with a sharp TFT display and robot status icons.

The UGREEN Nexode 45W Charger features a built-in 0.7m retractable fast-charging cable, eliminating the need to pack loose wires. Powered by GaNInfinity technology and equipped with 3 total ports, it delivers professional 45W charging (supporting Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0) while maintaining an ultra-compact footprint ideal for travel and everyday carry.

The EcoFlow DELTA 3 is a powerful 1024Wh portable power station featuring ultra-fast X-Stream AC charging that hits 100% in just 56 minutes. With 1800W continuous output (up to 2400W/3600W via X-Boost), 11 versatile ports, whisper-quiet 30dB operation, and expandability up to 5 kWh using compatible extra batteries, it delivers robust off-grid and backup energy.

The EcoFlow RIVER 2 Max is a portable 512Wh power station weighing just 6.1 kg with 60-minute AC recharge capability. Equipped with a long-lasting LFP battery rated for over 3,000 cycles, 500W continuous output (boostable to 1000W), and comprehensive app control, it delivers reliable off-grid power.

The BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 is an ultracompact 1024Wh power station weighing just 11.5 kg with a 17L volume design. Featuring 1800W continuous output (2700W lifting power), rapid 1200W AC TurboBoost charging, a massive 1000W solar input, and a seamless 10ms UPS backup, it delivers robust off-grid and emergency power.

The EcoFlow RAPID Pro Power Bank (27,650mAh, 300W) delivers a staggering 300W total output across four USB-C ports, featuring dual 140W single-port outputs and a 60cm retractable 140W built-in cable. Packed with an airline-compliant 99.54Wh capacity, a 20-minute 80% fast recharge via the 320W charging station, and modular magnetic cases, it represents the pinnacle of high-output travel charging.

The EcoFlow RAPID Pro Desktop Charger (320W, 5 Ports) is an advanced GaN-powered multi-port charging station engineered to deliver a massive 320W total output. Featuring dual 140W USB-C ports, an integrated Pogo Pin docking interface for RAPID Pro power banks, an LCD screen, and smart app-controlled energy management, it acts as the ultimate power hub for demanding multi-device setups.

The EcoFlow RAPID Power Bank (25,000mAh, 170W) delivers a total output of 170W across three ports, featuring dual 140W USB-C single-port outputs and a 33W USB-A port. With an airline-friendly 25,000mAh capacity, 140W ultra-fast recharging (0-50% in 20 minutes), and a smart TFT screen, it provides robust mobile productivity.

The BLUETTI Elite 10 Mini packs a 128Wh LiFePO4 battery and a 200W AC outlet (300W peak) into an ultra-lightweight 1.8 kg handheld chassis. Featuring a 10ms UPS mode, 150W turbo AC recharging (70 mins to full), 100W USB-C fast charging, solar/car input options, and smart Bluetooth app control, it bridges the gap between high-capacity power banks and compact generators.

The BLUETTI Elite 300 is a Frost & Sullivan-certified ultra-compact 3kWh portable power station packing 3,014.4Wh of capacity and 2,400W of continuous AC output (4,800W peak) into a remarkably small footprint. Featuring an RV-ready 12V/30A DC port, dual high-wattage USB-C ports (up to 140W), 1,200W solar input, a 10ms UPS mode, and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi app control, it delivers robust off-grid and emergency power.
The UGREEN Nexode Pro Powerbank combines a 25000 mAh capacity with a 200W total output, featuring PD 3.1 support and an intelligent TFT display.

The UGREEN Nexode Power Bank (25,000mAh, 145W) features advanced PD 3.1 technology to deliver a 140W max single-port output and 145W total combined output across three ports. Built with an airline-safe 90Wh capacity, digital LED display, and pass-through charging support, it delivers high-speed mobile power for laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

The UGREEN Nexode Pro Power Bank (10,000mAh, 55W) utilizes exclusive AirPyra technology to pack a 36Wh capacity into an ultra-lightweight 249g body. Featuring a built-in 22cm Type-C cable, 55W Xiaomi Mi Turbo charging, and 45W Power Delivery fast charge support, it delivers high performance in a pocket-friendly form factor.

The BLUETTI Elite 400 is a heavy-duty portable power station featuring 3,840Wh LFP battery and a 2,600W AC output with 3,900W Power Lifting. Equipped with smooth-rolling transport wheels, a 15ms UPS switching time, and lightning-fast 2,800W dual charging that reaches 80% in just 70 minutes, it provides reliable off-grid and emergency backup power.

The BLUETTI Pioneer Na is an interesting portable power station which is utilizing sodium-ion chemistry to deliver performance in freezing temperatures down to -25°C. Featuring a 900Wh capacity, 1,500W AC output (2,250W lifting power), and fast dual AC and solar charging that reaches 80% in just 35 minutes, it offers robust and reliable off-grid power.

The UGREEN Nexode Pro 160W 5-Port USB-C Charger features an intelligent smart display with touch control, a 360° rotating interface, and advanced GaN technologies. Delivering up to 140W from a single port and 160W total output across 5 ports, it provides rapid, real-time monitored charging for laptops, tablets, and phones.

The UGREEN Nexode 300W Desktop Charger is a powerhouse 5-port charging station utilizing advanced GaN technology and PD 3.1 support. Delivering up to 140W from a single port and a massive 300W total output, it can simultaneously fast-charge up to three laptops along with tablets and smartphones.
